title: Exploring the association between circadian rhythms and osteoporosis: new diagnostic and therapeutic targets identified via machine learning.
summary: Four ML algorithms compared to select circadian-related osteoporosis genes; the SVM-derived five-gene diagnostic model was evaluated on a separate GEO dataset (AUC 0.904 training; 0.887 validation). Retrospective diagnostic performance only; no clinical-benefit claim. The bibliographic records retrieved do not state an author affiliation.
